vendorRegistry.name: STAARS Vendor Self Service
vendorRegistry.notes: STAARS VSS is Alabama's central vendor system; official guidance states vendors can register, maintain account information, view solicitations, responses, awards, purchase history and financial transaction history.

awardSource.name: STAARS Vendor Self Service Public Access
awardSource.notes: Official Alabama VSS FAQ states open opportunities and awards can be viewed without a vendor account through Public Access.

vendorRegistry.name: State of Alaska Vendor Self Service
vendorRegistry.notes: Alaska Division of Finance identifies Vendor Self Service as the state vendor/payee system and supports vendor registration, payment visibility and solicitation response.

awardSource.name: State of Alaska Procurement / Contract Award Sources
awardSource.notes: Central vendor resources link VSS and Online Public Notice. Alaska DOT&PF separately exposes contract award status, historical bid data, RFP award status and vendor lists. A statewide normalized award extraction route still requires validation.

vendorRegistry.name: Arizona Procurement Portal (APP)
vendorRegistry.notes: Arizona Department of Administration requires businesses doing business with the state to register in APP.

awardSource.name: Arizona State Procurement Office Contracts / APP Public Portal
awardSource.notes: Arizona SPO provides searchable active contracts by supplier, contract number and keywords and points to APP for real-time public contract data.

vendorRegistry.name: Arkansas Vendor Services / ARBuy
vendorRegistry.notes: Arkansas Vendor Services is the official vendor registration system; ARBuy is the state's electronic bidding/eProcurement system.

awardSource.name: ARBuy / State Procurement Open Bids and Award Records
awardSource.notes: Official Arkansas sources confirm ARBuy as the state eProcurement platform. Award extraction and historical spend route still require endpoint-level validation before ingestion.
